title: Joint groundwater plus surface-water SWAP transaction participant
purpose: Create one bounded participant that owns one SWAP checkpoint/candidate while exposing both the MODFLOW bottom-interface response and the Ribasim signed surface-water exchange.
required_contract: one joint forcing assembled by surface-water-head then groundwater-head materialization
groundwater q_swap and optional accepted bottom-head tangent from that candidate
signed surface-water exchange from that same candidate
realized Ribasim surface transfer must match requested candidate transfer before publication_ready
MODFLOW residual convergence alone is insufficient for publication readiness
surface mismatch blocks commit without mutating committed SWAP state
discard keeps the same accepted origin for recomposition
successful publication performs exactly one kernel commit
cases: B1 positive surface drainage, matched Ribasim receipt, one commit
B2 negative surface infiltration, matched receipt, one commit
B3 surface receipt mismatch, commit blocked, discard and same-origin replay
B4 stale accepted origin fails closed
pass_meaning: Transaction-level authority for a single SWAP participant suitable for later joint MODFLOW/Ribasim orchestration.
